settings.visualStyle: Bastogne December 1944 historical reenactment, embedded winter field-camera realism, snow-filled foxholes, bare trees, freezing fog, scarce supplies, U.S. airborne and infantry field gear, muted blue-grey 35mm wartime color, non-graphic combat, no modern objects.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 connected scenes x 8 seconds. Follow one fictional U.S. defender through foxholes, woods, artillery bursts, brief shelter, ammunition checks, dusk patrol and night hold. No dialogue or narrator. One primary action and one camera movement per scene. Preserve snow, mud, fatigue and gear continuity.
settings.customVisualStyle: Cold defensive winter film look with snow on shoulders, fog between trees, breath vapor, frozen earth, intermittent artillery and long quiet gaps.

movie.plotDetails: Fictional composite U.S. defender used as a continuity anchor around Bastogne during the Battle of the Bulge.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Create an immersive two-minute historical reenactment around Bastogne in December 1944. Follow one fictional U.S. defender from a snow foxhole through artillery bursts, forest movement, a tiny rear shelter, scarce ammunition, dusk patrol, night tension and another frozen morning. No dialogue or narration. Emphasize cold, isolation and physical fatigue as much as combat. Keep violence non-graphic.
movie.storySummary: A U.S. defender begins the day in a frozen foxhole. The woods seem quiet until artillery bursts over the snow. The soldier returns fire briefly, moves between positions, spends a short moment warming his hands in a crude shelter and returns to the line. Ammunition is checked carefully, another barrage hits, dusk turns blue and night settles over the foxholes. Morning arrives with the defense still in place.
movie.storyTitle: WWII FRONTLINE FOOTAGE EP09 — Bastogne 1944: Surrounded in Snow

scenes.title: Frozen Foxhole
scenes.description: A defender peers from a snow-lined foxhole at first light.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier rubs gloved hands once, then raises his head above the foxhole edge.
scenes.imageDescription: Bastogne December 1944, snowy foxhole, bare trees, U.S. defender in winter field gear and M1 helmet, visible breath, muted blue-grey film color.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow trench-level push toward the soldier as he looks out. Audio: wind, breath, snow creak, distant artillery.

scenes.title: Quiet Woods
scenes.description: The defender moves between bare trees on a short perimeter check.
scenes.actionDescription: He walks carefully through knee-deep snow, scanning the foggy tree line.
scenes.imageDescription: Sparse snow forest, frozen fog, U.S. defender moving with rifle low, same winter gear, no visible enemy.
scenes.videoPrompt: Handheld follow between trees. Audio: snow crunch, wind, gear, distant low rumble.

scenes.title: Artillery Breaks the Silence
scenes.description: Shells begin landing farther along the perimeter.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier drops back into the foxhole as snow showers down from nearby impacts.
scenes.imageDescription: Snow plumes beyond foxholes, U.S. defenders low in cover, non-graphic artillery pressure.
scenes.videoPrompt: Impact-driven shake and fast drop to low trench view. Audio: artillery booms, snow debris, muffled recovery, breath.

scenes.title: Hold the Edge
scenes.description: The defenders answer briefly from the line.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier fires several controlled shots toward a distant treeline, then lowers back into cover.
scenes.imageDescription: Snow foxhole firing position, dark treeline distant, U.S. rifleman with winter gear, no enemy mixed into friendly position.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low over-shoulder shot with brief firing sequence only. Audio: rifle shots, distant answering fire, wind.

scenes.title: Move Between Positions
scenes.description: A section shifts along the forest edge to reinforce another foxhole.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier crouch-runs from one tree cluster to the next with two comrades.
scenes.imageDescription: Snow forest movement, U.S. defenders using trees as cover, fog, disturbed snow, no close enemy.
scenes.videoPrompt: Lateral handheld tracking between tree trunks. Audio: boots, gear, distant gunfire.

scenes.title: A Tiny Shelter
scenes.description: The soldier spends a short moment in a crude shelter behind the line.
scenes.actionDescription: He cups his hands near a tiny heat source and exhales slowly.
scenes.imageDescription: Improvised winter shelter, tarps, crates, dim light, same soldier with wet snow melting on sleeves, no comfort or luxury.
scenes.videoPrompt: Quiet close shot from hands to tired face. Audio: small fire crackle, wind outside, breathing, distant artillery.

scenes.title: Back Into the Cold
scenes.description: The pause ends and the soldier returns to the exposed line.
scenes.actionDescription: He steps from shelter into windblown snow and descends into the foxhole again.
scenes.imageDescription: Transition from dim shelter to bright cold snow, same soldier returning with identical gear and accumulated dampness.
scenes.videoPrompt: Follow behind from shelter doorway to foxhole. Audio: wind rises, boots in snow, gear.

scenes.title: Watch the Treeline
scenes.description: Fog and bare trunks make distant movement difficult to read.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier remains still behind a tree and scans left to right without firing.
scenes.imageDescription: Foggy snow forest, U.S. defender half concealed by tree trunk, distant treeline, no visible enemy required.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow lateral scan with soldier foreground. Audio: wind, branch creak, faint distant engine or artillery.

scenes.title: Ammunition Count
scenes.description: Limited supplies make every remaining clip and cartridge matter.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier checks his ammunition pouches, closes them and looks back toward the line.
scenes.imageDescription: Close field gear in snowy foxhole, gloved hands checking ammunition, rifle resting along trench edge.
scenes.videoPrompt: Tight close-up on hands and pouches, then small tilt to face. Audio: fabric, metal, breathing, distant shelling.

scenes.title: Second Barrage
scenes.description: Another artillery burst shakes the same defensive position.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier braces both hands against the frozen wall while snow and earth fall into the foxhole.
scenes.imageDescription: Frozen foxhole under shelling, snow and dirt falling, U.S. soldier low, no graphic casualties.
scenes.videoPrompt: Short heavy shake, then low stillness after blast. Audio: artillery, debris, ringing-like dullness, breath.

scenes.title: Reinforce the Woods
scenes.description: The section moves through the trees again as the barrage eases.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier advances along the forest edge to a new shallow fighting position.
scenes.imageDescription: Snowy woods, disturbed snow, tired U.S. defenders moving after bombardment, grey sky.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear three-quarter tracking through trees. Audio: snow, gear, distant fire, wind.

scenes.title: Blue Dusk Patrol
scenes.description: The woods become blue and indistinct as daylight fades.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier walks slowly along a narrow snow track and stops to listen.
scenes.imageDescription: Blue-hour winter forest, fog, U.S. defender moving cautiously, visible breath.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow forward drift ending in a still listening pose. Audio: wind, snow crunch, very distant combat.

scenes.title: Night Hold
scenes.description: Darkness settles over the foxholes while distant flashes mark the horizon.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier sits low with rifle across his knees and watches the faint flashes.
scenes.imageDescription: Night foxhole, dark trees, distant battlefield flashes, breath vapor, no active close combat.
scenes.videoPrompt: Static low-light shot with subtle exposure changes from distant flashes. Audio: wind, far artillery, breath.

scenes.title: Another Frozen Morning
scenes.description: Pale morning returns over the same snowbound defensive line.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier rises stiffly from the foxhole and brushes fresh snow from his shoulders.
scenes.imageDescription: Pale dawn, same foxhole geometry, more churned snow, exhausted defender rising with same gear.
scenes.videoPrompt: Gentle upward movement with the soldier. Audio: fabric, snow, breath, distant guns.

scenes.title: Still Holding
scenes.description: The episode ends with the defensive line remaining in place beneath a cold white sky.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier walks along the line past other tired defenders and disappears between the trees.
scenes.imageDescription: Snow forest perimeter, U.S. defenders spaced among foxholes and trees, same lead soldier receding, no celebration.
scenes.videoPrompt: Long rear closing shot through trees. Audio: snow steps, wind, distant artillery, restrained score tail.

characters.name: Snow Line Soldier

continuity.continuityRules: Same face, helmet, rifle and winter clothing throughout. Snow, moisture and exhaustion accumulate; no random dry or clean reset.

props.personalProps: rifle, M1 helmet, gloves, scarf, ammunition pouches
